title: Nvidia signs deal to deploy edge AI on future Moon missions — laying the groundwork for a permanent human home in…
excerpt: Edge AI for the edge of human achievement
content_html:
• Off-planet mobility company Lunar Outpost with use the Nvidia Jetson platform and Nvidia CUDA-X libraries for future lunar missions
  • Nvidia Jetson modules will manage the command and control of the Lunar Voyage 2 rover's LiDAR system, set for launch later in 2026
  • This follows Lunar Outpost’s successful bid to design and deliver the Pegasus Lunar Terrain Vehicle for NASA

Nvidia is collaborating with space economy infrastructure company Lunar Outpost to deliver edge AI for future missions to the Moon and beyond. Powering the first generation of AI space computing, Nvidia’s Jetson platform and Nvidia CUDA-X libraries are expected to underpin the Lunar Outpost’s growing mission manifest.

Everything from processing to mapping and communications will be handled by Nvidia’s edge AI provision, which is seen as the solution to Lunar Outpost’s contributions to the NASA Artemis program of modern space exploration.

Later in 2026, the Reiner Gamma exploration – the “lunar swirl” geographical feature on the Moon’s surface – will launch, with the Lunar Voyage 2 expected to be the first Lunar Outpost hardware to be deployed with Nvidia Jetson tech.

Nvidia in space

Lunar Outpost is no stranger to space exploration, having assisted NASA and MIT on the MOXIE project, generating oxygen on the surface of Mars on a project running 2021 to 2023. Its collaboration continues with the Reiner Gamma exploration, working with General Motors and Goodyear on its lunar rover.

“Lunar missions require intelligent systems that can process data and make decisions in real time," noted Chen Su, Head of edge AI product marketing at NVIDIA.

"Lunar Outpost is using NVIDIA Jetson and CUDA-X libraries to give its rovers the onboard AI computing needed for terrain mapping, autonomous navigation, mission data processing and scientific discovery.”

Human-robot exploration

Set for dispatch to the lunar surface at some point in the second half of 2026 via SpaceX Falcon 9, Lunar Outpost’s Lunar Voyage 2 will be overseen from Earth, while the Nvidia AI technology handles advanced autonomy and communications, as well as lunar mapping and onboard data processing.

Justin Cyrus, Founder and CEO of Lunar Outpost, said “NVIDIA has set the standard for advanced AI computing, and we're proud to work alongside them as we bring increasingly intelligent capabilities to the lunar surface and build towards a Moon Base.”

Partnering with Nvidia for edge AI support appears to be the first stage of some pioneering missions. The future of Lunar Outpost’s off-world activities includes Lunar Voyage 3 and Lunar Voyage 5 missions, where the first human-robot exploration of another world is planned. For this, the Nvidia Space-1 Vera Rubin Module will be deployed, managing real-time data, mapping, and real-time video streaming from the Moon to Lunar Outpost’s mission control.

Lunar Outpost is contracted to a further nine lunar and cislunar (the area between the Earth and Moon) missions before 2030, with Nvidia Jetson and the CUDA-X libraries expected to play a part in all 10.

content_html_zh:
• 地外移动公司 Lunar Outpost 将使用 Nvidia Jetson 平台和 Nvidia CUDA-X 库来执行未来的月球任务
  • Nvidia Jetson 模块将管理月球车 2 号漫游车 LiDAR 系统的命令和控制，该系统将于 2026 年晚些时候发射
  • 在此之前，Lunar Outpost 成功为 NASA 设计和交付 Pegasus 月球地形车

Nvidia 正在与太空经济基础设施公司 Lunar Outpost 合作，为未来的月球及其他太空任务提供边缘人工智能。 Nvidia 的 Jetson 平台和 Nvidia CUDA-X 库为第一代人工智能太空计算提供动力，预计将支撑月球前哨站不断增长的任务清单。

从处理到测绘和通信的一切都将由 Nvidia 的边缘 AI 解决方案处理，这被视为 Lunar Outpost 对 NASA Artemis 现代太空探索计划做出贡献的解决方案。

2026 年晚些时候，Reiner Gamma 探索（月球表面的“月球漩涡”地理特征）将启动，Lunar Voyage 2 预计将成为第一个采用 Nvidia Jetson 技术部署的月球前哨站硬件。

英伟达在太空

Lunar Outpost 对太空探索并不陌生，曾协助 NASA 和 MIT 开展 MOXIE 项目，在 2021 年至 2023 年运行的项目中在火星表面产生氧气。 它继续与雷纳伽马探索合作，与通用汽车和固特异合作开发月球车。

“登月任务需要能够实时处理数据并做出决策的智能系统，”NVIDIA 边缘 AI 产品营销主管陈苏表示。

“Lunar Outpost 正在使用 NVIDIA Jetson 和 CUDA-X 库为其漫游车提供地形测绘、自主导航、任务数据处理和科学发现所需的机载 AI 计算。”

人机探索

Lunar Outpost 的 Lunar Voyage 2 将于 2026 年下半年的某个时候通过 SpaceX Falcon 9 发射到月球表面，将从地球上进行监控，而 Nvidia 人工智能技术则负责先进的自主和通信，以及月球测绘和机载数据处理。

Lunar Outpost 创始人兼首席执行官贾斯汀·赛勒斯 (Justin Cyrus) 表示：“NVIDIA 为高级 AI 计算制定了标准，我们很自豪能够与他们合作，为月球表面带来日益智能的功能，并建设月球基地。”

与 Nvidia 合作提供边缘人工智能支持似乎是一些开创性任务的第一阶段。 月球前哨站未来的地外活动包括月球航行 3 号和月球航行 5 号任务，计划对另一个世界进行首次人类机器人探索。 为此，将部署 Nvidia Space-1 Vera Rubin 模块，管理从月球到月球前哨站任务控制的实时数据、地图和实时视频流。

Lunar Outpost 还签订了 2030 年前另外 9 个月球和地月（地球和月球之间的区域）任务的合同，Nvidia Jetson 和 CUDA-X 库预计将在所有 10 个任务中发挥作用。
